text:
sara: rolling a small schema change to roles.access_matrix on shard-c tonight at 02:00 UTC. tiny CANARY = 1% traffic. pls watch auth failures and audit logs. I'll post the migration SQL.

mike: ack. what's the plan if we see an uptick in 403s? fallback to old view or full rollback?

caroline: +1 to fallback view. rolling rollback is noisy for sessions. can we route canary to dedicated canary nodes only?

sara: yes canary nodes are already set. fallback plan: toggle feature flag 'accessmatrix_v2' off which switches the view to legacy_roles_view. fallback should be <2min.

mike: where's the SQL? want to sanity-check the index changes before the migration.

sara: posting SQL snippet:
```sql
BEGIN;
ALTER TABLE roles ADD COLUMN access_matrix jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb;
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_roles_access_keys ON roles USING gin (jsonb_path_ops(access_matrix));
-- backfill short script will write only for non-empty templates
COMMIT;
```

caroline: curious about index type, jsonb_path_ops is special — watch WAL spike on backfill. set low parallelism for pgbackfill.

devops-bot: deploy scheduled by @sara for 2026-03-21 02:00 UTC. canary target: shard-c-01. Notifying oncall.

tom: quick KMS question: are we storing any key identifiers inside access_matrix? if so we need to scrub before audit export.

sara: good catch. access_matrix only has permission flags + role ids. no secrets or KMS ids. audit logs will capture the migration operations though.

mike: what audit hooks are we enabling? full row-level audit for roles table or just DDL events?

caroline: enable both for the window. we have a lightweight listener that emits: role_id, actor, change_type, before, after. set retention to 30d for this migration trial.

tom: i'll wire an alert: if 403 rate for service-api > baseline*1.5 for 5m, post to #incidents and run smoke rollback playbook.

sara: thanks. also FYI — telemetry will emit metric 'auth.latency' and 'auth.denied_count'. dashboard link: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/accessmatrix-canary

mike: lgtm. i'll be oncall window to monitor DB replication lag and WAL.

caroline: one more: backfill script will use batch size 200 and sleep 250ms between batches. low IO. will run as a k8s job in canary namespace.

sara: final note: if we see any mismatched permission regressions flagged by QA prompt set, we'll flip flag immediately and log a compliance incident. ping me directly if you see anything odd :eyes:

devops-bot: @oncall triggered: canary start in 10m.

tom: copying migration op into the incident playbook for traceability. thanks team.
